about_the_game:
The demo version allows progress only up to a certain point, but the features and gameplay are the same as the full version.

Save data cannot be transferred to the full version.

Naroike is a casual side-scrolling game that combines roguelite and hack-and-slash elements.

Collect a wide variety of artifacts and use your skills to defeat enemies.

Strengthen not only your equipment but also your skill tree to create a playstyle that suits you.

Keep playing, keep growing, and enjoy fast-paced, exhilarating battles!

  • A Wide Variety of Artifacts

Combine various artifacts freely to create the ultimate build that suits your playstyle.

Additionally, some artifacts come with Action Skills, further expanding your combat possibilities.

  • Skill Tree System

Beyond artifacts, the Skill Tree allows you to enhance your character permanently.

Progress that stays with you – even if you die, your upgrades remain.

Combine the Skill Tree with artifacts to become an unstoppable warrior!

  • Action Skills

Some artifacts are equipped with Action Skills, giving you a major edge in battle.

Master your skills and carve out your own unique fighting style!

  • The Lost System

In this world, death takes everything.

All artifacts and equipment you acquire during your adventure will be lost if you die…

However, if you can reach the same location again without dying, you can recover everything you lost!

Should you retreat safely, or risk everything for greater rewards? The choice between survival and ambition will determine your fate.

  • Face Formidable Foes

Every 100 meters, a powerful boss awaits. Defeating them will reward you with permanent artifacts that you can keep even after death!

Enemies grow stronger the further you progress.

The deeper you go, the more powerful artifacts you can obtain.

Choosing when to fight or flee is the key to survival.

If you die, you lose everything. But if you dare to challenge fate, you may unlock incredible power.

Survive, push forward, and go beyond your limits!
